title: Multi-Bin Batching for Increasing LLM Inference Throughput
authors: Ozgur Guldogan; Jackson Kunde; Kangwook Lee; Ramtin Pedarsani
affiliations: University of California Santa Barbara, University of Wisconsin-Madison
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Length prediction, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Queueing theory

problem_statement.en: Under standard batched LLM inference, requests with widely differing output lengths share a batch and the computing unit stays locked until the longest request completes, causing severe resource underutilization that offsets the throughput gains of parallel batching.
problem_statement.zh: 標準批次推理下，輸出長度差異大的請求被綁在同一批次，運算單元須等到批次中最長請求完成才能釋放，導致嚴重資源閒置，抵消批次平行化所帶來的吞吐量增益。

key_innovation.en: Multi-Bin Batching (k-Bin Batching): a queueing-theoretic control policy that classifies arriving requests into k bins by predicted output length with equal-probability-mass boundaries derived in closed form, then forms size-B batches within each bin and serves bins under FCFS. Proven to be asymptotically throughput-optimal as k grows.
key_innovation.zh: 提出 Multi-Bin Batching（k-Bin Batching）：以 queueing theory 為基礎的控制策略，依預測輸出長度將請求分入 k 個 bins，並以封閉解導出等機率質量的邊界；每個 bin 內形成 size-B 批次，再以 FCFS 服務。證明當 k 增大時為漸近吞吐量最佳。

key_improvements.en: Up to 70 percent throughput improvement over standard batching with oracle output-length information; with k=32 bins approaches theoretical maximum capacity; robust to symmetric output-length prediction errors, with throughput increasing in k even under noisy predictions.
key_improvements.zh: 在 oracle 輸出長度資訊下，吞吐量較標準批次最多提升 70%；k=32 時逼近理論最大容量；對 symmetric 輸出長度預測誤差亦具穩健性，吞吐量在含雜訊預測下仍隨 k 上升。

reported_accuracy: Linear inference-time fit at 0.0366 seconds per generated token on Phi-3.5-mini-instruct
validation_workloads: GSM8K, Synthetic (Poisson arrivals with uniform and exponential service-time distributions)

scope_assumptions.en: Single-server queueing model with infinite queue capacity, Poisson arrivals, i.i.d. uniform service times in [l_min, l_max] (main analysis; exponential in appendix). Batch service time equals the maximum among the B requests. Continuous batching is explicitly out of scope. Requires an output-length predictor (oracle in main experiments).
scope_assumptions.zh: 假設單伺服器 queue 模型、無窮佇列容量、Poisson 到達，主分析設定服務時間為 i.i.d. 均勻分佈 [l_min, l_max]（exponential 結果置於附錄）。批次服務時間取 B 個請求中的最大值。Continuous batching 明確排除於範圍外。需要輸出長度預測器（主要實驗使用 oracle）。
